Move task storage operations such as add, remove, lookup, sizing, and iteration behind a dedicated TaskList class. Keep Oreo's command behavior and persistence format unchanged while establishing the first OOP boundary for further extractions.

Move task file loading and atomic saving behind a dedicated Storage class, including encoded records and legacy-format compatibility. Keep Oreo focused on command flow while preserving all existing user-visible behavior.

Introduce a Parser abstraction for translating user input into command types and route Oreo through it. Preserve all existing command recognition and user-facing behavior while separating parsing from the command loop.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract greeting and goodbye messages into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Move the user-facing startup and shutdown messages into a dedicated Ui class. Update the UI test plan to document existing end-to-end coverage and preserve all console output.

Centralize task status confirmations and command error messages in Ui, removing the corresponding console formatting methods from Oreo. Preserve existing output and document behavior through the UI regression suite.
Centralize task listing and add/delete confirmations in Ui, leaving Oreo responsible for command flow and task mutations. Preserve all existing console output verified by the UI regression suite.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move date query display into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Centralize date-query formatting and result display in Ui while leaving date validation and command routing in Oreo. Preserve existing query behavior as verified by all UI regression cases.

Remove the obsolete persistence implementation and its file-I/O imports from Oreo after routing all loading and saving through Storage. Fix the class closing boundary and preserve behavior verified by all UI tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move command argument extraction into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Centralize extraction of arguments following task commands in Parser and route Oreo through it. Preserve command validation and all existing user-visible behavior, verified by the complete UI regression suite.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move structured command parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Extract deadline and event argument splitting and validation into Parser, leaving Oreo to construct tasks from parsed parts. Preserve existing error messages and behavior as verified by all UI tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move to-do argument validation into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Centralize validation of empty to-do descriptions in Parser alongside the other command argument rules. Preserve the existing error message and user-visible behavior verified by the complete UI suite.
Centralize one-based task-number parsing and range validation in Parser for mark, unmark, and delete commands. Preserve existing error messages and behavior verified by all UI tests.

Add the abstract Command execution contract and implement ExitCommand for the bye flow. Route Oreo through the command lifecycle while preserving all existing console behavior verified by the UI suite.
Move task-list display behind the Command execution abstraction and keep Oreo responsible only for selecting the command. Preserve existing list output as verified by all UI tests.
Move task-number validation, removal, persistence, and confirmation for delete into a dedicated Command implementation. Preserve existing behavior and error handling verified by all UI tests.

Add a shared TaskStatusCommand workflow with MarkCommand and UnmarkCommand implementations. Move status validation, mutation, persistence, and confirmation out of Oreo while preserving all UI behavior.

Add a shared AddTaskCommand workflow with TodoCommand, DeadlineCommand, and EventCommand implementations. Move task parsing, creation, persistence, and confirmation out of Oreo while preserving all UI behavior.
Move date validation and date-query execution into a dedicated Command implementation, leaving Oreo to dispatch the command. Preserve existing date-query behavior and errors verified by all UI tests.
Represent empty and unrecognized input as Command implementations so Oreo delegates all command outcomes through execute. Preserve existing error messages and behavior verified by all UI tests.
Add Parser.parseCommand to map complete user input directly to Command objects and simplify Oreo's main loop to parse, execute, and inspect exit state. Preserve all behavior verified by the UI suite.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move command input handling into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Let Ui own standard-input scanning and expose command-oriented read methods, simplifying Oreo's run loop while preserving exact console behavior verified by all UI tests.
Add Ui.showLine for the standard response divider and use it for standalone divider output. Preserve exact user-facing formatting as verified by all UI tests.
Make Ui, Parser, Storage, and TaskList instance collaborators, initialize application state in Oreo's constructor, and expose a dedicated run method. Preserve behavior verified by all UI tests.
Change Parser.parse to return Command objects directly, matching the stretch-goal API and simplifying Oreo's parse-execute loop. Preserve all existing behavior verified by the UI regression suite.

Separate command recognition and argument extraction in Parser from concrete command creation in CommandFactory. Preserve the existing parse-execute flow and all user-visible behavior verified by the UI suite.
Give command implementations a common inherited Parser helper and remove repeated parser construction from task commands. Preserve command behavior and all UI regression results.

Make Parser an explicit dependency of the command hierarchy and construct commands with the shared parser from CommandFactory. Remove hidden parser creation to improve testability and preserve all UI behavior.
Make command construction an explicit Parser dependency and initialize it in Oreo. Remove hidden factory creation while preserving the complete command flow and UI behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor command execution around application context
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce AppContext to bundle TaskList, Ui, and Storage for command execution. Update the command hierarchy and Oreo loop to pass one cohesive execution context, reducing parameter coupling while preserving all existing behavior and output.
